reply_text:
I told Marcus in a thread on their question in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team. Marcus is a member of that channel, so they could already see it. I read only #north-team, and nothing posted there since 14 October changes the date. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed to share it.

My summary from last time also shows up as a separate message in #north-team, next to the threaded reply to Ilse. It repeats the same information, so nothing new was shared, but it is an extra post in the channel.
